findings.title: Blue Nile's 18K ring page contradicts itself on the metal
Only {n_weight_published_total} of {n_combined} listings publish a weight - none from this pass's five retailers
None of this pass's five retailers states a hallmark or maker's-mark policy
{n_solid_gold_null} of {n_solid_gold} listings never use the word 'solid'
Ring Concierge's Trustpilot score is based on 7 reviews and an unclaimed profile
Ring Concierge advertises a lifetime warranty while its refund policy says 3 years
Blue Nile excludes resized rings from returns and limits free returns to two per year
Short return windows: Aurate 15 days, Catbird 20 days (plus a $9 fee)
Ring Concierge rings mix two metals - a single karat claim cannot cover the whole ring
Mejuri's main /help hub requires JavaScript, while direct leaf FAQ articles render server-side
In this pass, 18K prices exist only for Blue Nile settings
Two independent spot-price sources agree to within 0.06%
Aurate's $2,858 solitaire is "Exchange for size only. Final Sale!" on a page that also shows a "Free Returns" badge
Dataset A said "no ring weight" for the Aurate solitaire — the listing does publish one, as a range
A 3% fee belonging to Wilson's had been attached to Sarraf in the flag legend
Automic Gold's return window was recorded as unstated; the page states 30 days, and states its lead time three ways
Ross-Simons and Catbird return policies were "Not verified" in Dataset B while Dataset A already had Catbird's quoted
Third independent read of the gold spot anchor: $4,028.53/oz live against $4,026.79 and $4,024.36 on file
Sarraf's recorded e-mail address was wrong and its cited policy page returns 404
Automic Gold's cited return-policy URL returns 404, so its resize claim had no source
Sarraf counts returns over $10,000 as 'high-risk' behaviour under a three-strike policy
Two official Sarraf pages contradict each other on whether engraved rings can be returned
Three Catbird values drafted in this pass did not survive contact with the live pages
Catbird's /contact-us page returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-23 live re-verification
All 7 Aurate lab-grown engagement ring PDPs enforce 'Final Sale! / Exchange for size only.' + 30% MTO cancellation fee after 24h
Mejuri Slim Diamond Eternity Band (R03) live PDP reads 'From $898' vs $648 stored from collection grid (+38.6%)
Live PDP template specification bugs on Brilliant Earth SOL-05/R29 ('Band Width: 2 ct. tw.') and VRAI R28 ('Pavé carat weight: 0.11ctw' on Plain band)
Ring Concierge's $6,038 engagement-ring page claims both a 2.08 ct E VS1 stone and a 5.63 ct D VVS2 stone — and cuts the return window to 7 days
Systematic URL sweep caught five more 404 citations, two mis-transcribed phone numbers, and Menē's JS-gated weights
All seven Aurate engagement listings conflict 'Free Returns' with 'Exchange for size only. Final Sale!' — and two bezels misstate carat weight in their titles
Mejuri's Milestone collection card prints 'From $648' for Slim Diamond Eternity Band (R03), while clicking through to the 14k White Gold product page prints 'From $898' (+38.6%)
Wilson's Bailey Banks & Biddle 19K Art Deco ring (R13) DOES publish 'Total Weight: 6.5 grams' in chunk 1 — missed by five prior passes
Menē BBB profiles (0107-1413670 & 0107-1378080) are both 'Not Rated' — removing unverified 'D+' BBB grade on SEL-MENE
Two hallucinated 404 product URLs caught inside data/flags.json (WAR1 & SPEC5) plus four dead seller policy/contact URLs
Wilson's standalone refund-policy page contradicts its product-page Domestic Returns tab on free US return labels
Sarraf's '± 5%' weight accuracy statement IS printed verbatim in chunk 4 (#tab-education) of R20, R26, and R27
